topic: Local and modern building construction material in Nepal

questions.q: 108. The standard size of a brick as per Nepal Standard (NS) is
questions.explain: The Nepal Standard (NS) specifies the brick size as 230mm x 115mm x 57mm.

questions.q: 123. For one cubic meter of brick masonry, the number of machine made brick required as per NS is
questions.explain: According to Nepal Standards, approximately 530 machine-made bricks are required to complete 1 cubic meter of masonry.

questions.q: 128. The amount of local brick required for one m3 masonry (As per NS norms)
questions.explain: Due to size variations in local traditional bricks in Nepal, the norm usually estimates 560 bricks per cubic meter.

questions.q: 166. The most widely used kiln in Nepal is
questions.explain: Bull's Trench Kiln is the most popular type in Nepal due to its cost-efficiency and ability to produce a large volume of bricks continuously.

questions.q: 258. During Rana Cracy, types of mortar generally used for public buildings are
questions.explain: Historically in Nepal (Rana Era), lime and surkhi (crushed brick) were the primary binding materials before cement became widely available.

questions.q: 433. Which type of timber is used for construction of houses in Himalayan Region of Nepal?
questions.explain: Sal (Shorea robusta) is highly valued for its durability and strength in Nepalese construction.

questions.q: 434. What is the minimum thickness of stone masonry wall in Nepal?
questions.explain: According to the Nepal National Building Code, 300 mm is typically the minimum specified thickness for load-bearing stone walls.

questions.q: 437. The recent material used in cladding multi storeyed commercial buildings in Kathmandu
questions.explain: Aluminium Composite Panels (ACP) are popular for modern commercial facades due to their lightweight and aesthetic appeal.
